title: NativeRNFSTurboPlatformContextModuleSpec Not Found
body:
Hi!

I am trying to add library, I run `npm i react-native-fs-turbo` and getting following error during build the app.

`> Task :react-native-fs-turbo:compileDebugJavaWithJavac FAILED
/Users/test/Documents/sme/smeApp/node_modules/react-native-fs-turbo/android/src/main/java/com/cmpayc/rnfsturbo/RNFSTurboPlatformContextModule.java:18: error: cannot find symbol
public class RNFSTurboPlatformContextModule extends NativeRNFSTurboPlatformContextModuleSpec {
                                                    ^
  symbol: class NativeRNFSTurboPlatformContextModuleSpec
/Users/test/Documents/sme/smeApp/node_modules/react-native-fs-turbo/android/src/main/java/com/cmpayc/rnfsturbo/RNFSTurboPackage.java:26: error: cannot find symbol
    if (name.equals(RNFSTurboPlatformContextModule.NAME)) {
                                                  ^
  symbol:   variable NAME
  location: class RNFSTurboPlatformContextModule`
  
  Please advice.
author: atifaziz1

comments.body:
Hey @atifaziz1 !
1. Make sure you have the new architecture enabled on Android:
  The file `android/gradle.properties` should contain a flag:
  `newArchEnabled=true`
2. If the new architecture is enabled, try deleting the `android/.gradle` folder and clean the cache using the command
  `cd android && ./gradlew clean`

title: More informative exceptions
body:
It would be great to throw the OS level exceptions instead of a generic message.

For example, when a file can't be read I receive the following:
`Error: Can not open file`

With `react-native-file-access`, I receive:
`java.io.FileNotFoundException: /storage/emulated/0/Pictures/IMG_20241128_174015.jpg: open failed: EACCES (Permission denied)`

With the latter, I will also immediately know whether the file actually exists or not. Also, these might end up as unhandled errors in a logger, so it's very useful to include as much info as possible.
author: netdown

comments.body: @netdown Yes, I agree. I haven't worked much on the error output yet. I'll have to make them more informative.

title: Absolute path uri does not resolve
body:
Hi,

Since i.e. react-native-cameraroll always returns a file uri (never a path), it would be great to support absolute path uri-s starting with file:///. Currently, these throw a file not found exception. Obviously, removing the prefix solves the issue, but IMO this should be handled at library level.
author: netdown

comments.body: Hey @netdown Yes, that's a good point. I'll work on that.
